title: Grimsby
summary: A town name with a hidden history. Investigate its ending.
question: What does the ending of Grimsby tell us?
completion: Ending explained! Grimsby’s -by is a Norse settlement word. The rest contains the personal name Grímr. The town stayed in England; its name carries a Scandinavian language connection.
partner: Town names can keep clues from languages spoken long ago.

sources.title: Lincolnshire Folk Tales Project · name elements and later legend
